detail.longDescription: I was doing some research and came accross this guide from OSTechNix - https://ostechnix.com/drop-in-d-directories-linux-configuration-explained/, which contains technical misinformation and appears to be written with generative AI to some extent, and this is just the first single article I've read on their site so now I'm wondering to which extent this is a common practice. Anyway I wanted to warn yall cause I haven't read any reviews on OSTechNix, so just another reminder not to blindly trust what you read on the internet.
